title: GCP Cloud SQL PostgreSQL Database
description: Managed relational database running PostgreSQL with private IP connectivity, SSD storage, automated backups, and restricted authorized networks

instance_name.title: Database Identifier
instance_name.description: Cloud SQL instance identifier (globally unique, lowercase)

gcp_project_id.title: GCP Project ID
gcp_project_id.description: GCP project ID where the database will be created

network_self_link.title: VPC Network Self-Link
network_self_link.description: Self-link URI of the VPC network for private IP connectivity (typically an output of the GCP VPC template)

manage_vpc_peering.title: Manage VPC Peering
manage_vpc_peering.description: Create the Service Networking peering connection (set false if peering is already managed elsewhere)

database_name.title: Database Name
database_name.description: Name of the application database created inside the instance

db_password.title: Master Password
db_password.description: Leave blank to generate a high-entropy cryptographically secure password

tier.title: Database Tier
tier.description: Cloud SQL machine tier (compute + memory sizing)

region.title: GCP Region
region.description: GCP region where the instance will be deployed

allocated_storage_gb.title: Allocated Storage (GB)
allocated_storage_gb.description: Initial SSD storage capacity in GB

disk_autoresize.title: Disk Auto-Resize
disk_autoresize.description: Automatically increase storage when nearing capacity

point_in_time_recovery.title: Point-In-Time Recovery
point_in_time_recovery.description: Enable point-in-time recovery from binary logs

backup_retention_count.title: Backup Retention (Count)
backup_retention_count.description: Number of automated backups to retain

deletion_protection.title: Deletion Protection
deletion_protection.description: Protect the instance from accidental deletion

allowed_ingress_cidrs.title: Authorized Networks
allowed_ingress_cidrs.description: CIDR blocks permitted to connect over the public path. Empty list restricts access to private IP only.
